candidate_contract.baseline: public Matching.decode_to_edges_array on the dense syndrome followed by per-selected-edge get_edge_data lookup
candidate_contract.candidate: numpy flatnonzero detection-event extraction, version-locked PyMatching C++ decode_to_edges_array on sparse event indices, and a graph-construction-time normalized edge-to-component dictionary
candidate_contract.preindex_rule: walk every merged matching edge before timing, require at most one fault ID, normalize undirected endpoints, and map its local fault ID through the frozen local_fault_to_component tuple
candidate_contract.private_api_boundary: diagnostic only; a pass must later be implemented through a supported or independently maintained native interface before production credit
unchanged: distance-6 circuits, noise, 1,000-round horizon, and frozen X/Z corpora
two-pass correlated matching graph and weights
correction propagation, logical-frame updates, and residual checks
one-microsecond p99 and one-percent miss thresholds

checks.detail: Every candidate phase sum equals total.
checks.name: phase_additivity

checks.detail: Score follows semantic veto and cannot waive deadline.
checks.name: score_guard

classification_rule.interpretation: the first measured software boundary is diagnostic and cannot prove a hardware bottleneck
classification_rule.rule: after the semantic veto, select the first stage failing p99 <=1 microsecond per committed layer and miss fraction <=1 percent in either basis: C++ correlated matching, preindexed mapping, then candidate direct end-to-end

corpus_contract.timed_order: baseline_then_candidate on even shots and candidate_then_baseline on odd shots

hard_boundaries.reason: the candidate is a same-host Python diagnostic around a private C++ interface, not a QPU, controller, supported production decoder, asynchronous device link, or hardware feedback path

kaggle_inspired_evaluation.absolute_guardrail: a relative improvement cannot waive the absolute tail and miss limits
kaggle_inspired_evaluation.aggregate: geometric mean across X and Z
kaggle_inspired_evaluation.reference_relative_cost: baseline direct p99 divided by candidate direct p99 per basis
kaggle_inspired_evaluation.verification_veto: candidate predictions, residuals, corpus hashes, graph structure, and preindex integrity must pass before a speedup is credited

known_before_preregistration.disclosure: the graph-only scan established that every merged edge exposes zero or one fault ID, allowing an exact preindex; no nonzero frozen-corpus candidate prediction, candidate timing vector, speedup, tail verdict, or classification has been observed

next_gate: Move beyond wrapper tuning: preregister a maintained native or alternate decoder kernel with identical window semantics.
question: Can a version-locked sparse detection-event call plus a preindexed edge-to-component map remove enough wrapper and lookup overhead to move the exact distance-6 correlated window decoder toward its one-microsecond tail budget?

scope.excluded_work: all catalog problems and research tracks other than #021/B7, #022/B2, and #023

timing_contract.raw_vectors: baseline direct total plus candidate direct total and all seven candidate phases as base64 little-endian uint64 nanoseconds
timing_contract.relative_score: baseline direct p99 divided by sparse-preindexed candidate p99 for X and Z, aggregated by geometric mean only after the semantic veto
